messages.subject: Scheduled DMS maintenance — Saturday 8 Feb, 20:00–23:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday from 8pm to 11pm for scheduled maintenance and indexing upgrades. Please save and close all documents before then. Email will be unaffected. Contact the helpdesk on x4357 with any questions.

IT Helpdesk
